_provenance.note: A forced non-zero exit cannot be recorded from a successful API call — hand-authored to exercise runJson's non-zero-exit throw path (exec.mjs:31-32). Neither prView/prReviews/labelEvents/prStatusRollup's never-throws convention nor mrList's caller-agnostic pin applies the same way here: github.mjs#issueList does not wrap the call in a try/catch, and both issueList call sites (tracker-board.mjs's safeList, project-status.mjs's wrapping try/catch) already absorb the throw — pinned as a documented, load-bearing divergence, not fixed here.
